entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please have your order number ready.
Yeah, yeah, I have it. Just get me to a person.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
I need to return a VeloBand. Order number is VF-881-9254. I need a return label.

Okay, I can certainly look into that for you. Let me just pull that up... I see the order for the VeloBand GPS Tracker. It looks like it was delivered 36 days ago. To make sure I understand, is it a technical fault or a preference issue?
It's not working. The pulse monitor is completely unreliable and now the band won't sync with my phone at all. For all intents and purposes, it's broken.
I understand. I'm very sorry to hear the device is defective. One moment while I review our return policy for you.
Look, I don't have time for a long hold. It's defective, I'm in the window, just send the label.

No hold necessary, I have the information right here. And I see you're one of our VIP members. The policy states a 90-day window for returns, so you are well within that timeframe. I can approve this return for you right now.
Great. That's what I needed to hear. Send it over.

Absolutely. I've just sent a pre-paid return label to the email we have on file. Once we receive the defective unit, we will issue a full refund to your original payment method. For the trouble, and as a thank you for being a VIP, I've also added a $20 credit to your account for future use.
Okay, I see the email. That's fine. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
